AboutSection.title: About us
AboutSection.body:
After an intensive seven-month renovation, we are proud to present our B&B.

When our two children moved out, we discovered that a large part of our home was no longer being used. That gave us the idea of converting the garage into an attractive bed & breakfast.

What started as a lovely plan soon grew into an extensive process involving permits, construction drawings, an architect, a website and a domain name. The to-do list kept getting longer, but the result was worth it.

Thanks to friends and family, who stayed with us as our very first trial guests, we gained the confidence that we had created something special. Of course, we are still learning every day, but above all we look forward to offering our guests a warm and comfortable stay.

We hope to welcome you soon.

AreaSection.title: Around the B&B: Kijkduin and The Hague
AreaSection.intro: Our B&B is in a quiet and convenient part of The Hague, within walking and cycling distance of Kijkduin beach. Nature and the city centre are easy to reach by bike, car or public transport.
AreaSection.empty: Add places in the translations to populate this overview.

accessibility.title: Getting here & parking
paragraphs: Our B&B is easy to reach both by car and by public transport. We offer free parking on our own property right in front of the B&B. There is also secure space to store bicycles.

Would you like to explore the area by bike? We recommend downloading the FIETSKNOOPPUNT app in advance. You can also easily rent (electric) bicycles from Orie Rijwielen, just 500 metres from our B&B. For rentals, you can contact them directly by email.
We are happy to help with practical advice and tips for scenic routes and useful local connections.

places.name: The Hague city centre
places.description: Ideal for shopping, museums, historic buildings and lively squares. The city centre includes the Binnenhof and many of The Hague's best-known sights.

places.name: Kijkduin
places.description: You can be on the beach within minutes by bike. Kijkduin is known for its quieter beaches and welcoming beach pavilions.

places.name: Scheveningen
places.description: Easy to reach by public transport or bicycle. Here you will find the Circustheater and the iconic Pier, among other attractions. In high season we advise against coming by car because of crowds and limited parking.

places.name: Ockenburgh estate
places.description: A beautiful green estate with woodland and walking paths, ideal for a relaxing walk. The estate has a restaurant and cafe, and live music is organised regularly.

places.name: Cycling routes
places.description: Several cycling junction routes connect to the national network nearby, including 21, 22 and 23 towards Kijkduin and the dunes, and 17 and 18 towards Westland and the southern coastal route. From here you can easily cycle to Westduinpark, Westland, Hoek van Holland or Meijendel.

places.name: Chilling at the beach
places.description: Suiderstrand, a wonderful spot to relax by the coast. Enjoy the sun, sea and wide sandy beach just a short distance from our B&B.

ConditionsPage.title: Conditions of B&B Klein Ockenburgh
ConditionsPage.intro: We do everything we can to make your stay as pleasant as possible. To keep expectations clear for both sides, the conditions below apply to every reservation.
ConditionsPage.acceptanceBody: By making a booking, the guest confirms that they have read and agree to these general conditions.
quickFacts: A booking on our website is final after full payment
Adults only, no pets and no smoking indoors
Cancellation and no-show: 100% of the reservation amount

sections.title: Rates and tourist tax
paragraphs: Our rates are based on one night for two guests, including breakfast and unlimited coffee and tea during the stay.
All prices include the applicable VAT rate and exclude tourist tax. Tourist tax is set by the municipality of The Hague and in 2026 amounts to EUR 6.20 per person per night.

sections.title: Check-in and check-out
paragraphs: Check-in is available from 13:00. Would you like to arrive at a different time? We are happy to arrange this with you. If we are not at home, you can let yourself in using a key safe and we will welcome you later.
Check-out is available between 08:00 and 10:30.

sections.title: Booking and payment
paragraphs: Bookings can be made through our website or via bedandbreakfast.nl. When you book through our website, we will send a confirmation by email with the invoice and payment instructions after receiving the reservation. The reservation is final once full payment has been received.
Any additional costs incurred during the stay must be settled at check-out. Payment can be made in cash or digitally via a payment request.
If payment is not made on time, the guest is automatically in default by law. Any reasonable collection and legal costs will be charged to the guest in accordance with the applicable legal rules.
We reserve the right to request a security deposit to cover possible damage.

sections.title: Cancellation and no-show
paragraphs: If the guest cancels, 100% of the reservation amount is due.
In the event of a no-show, 100% of the reservation amount will also be charged.
If the reservation was made through an external booking platform, the cancellation must be processed through that platform.

In the event of force majeure on the side of the B&B, such as fire, government measures or other unforeseen circumstances, we reserve the right to cancel the reservation. In that case, the guest will receive a refund of the amount paid or a voucher for the same value.

sections.title: House rules
paragraphs: We kindly ask our guests to treat the accommodation, inventory and surroundings with respect.
Smoking is not allowed indoors. Smoking outside is of course permitted.
Our B&B is adults only and is not equipped for children.
Pets are not allowed.
The number of guests may never exceed the number stated in the reservation confirmation.
Parties or gatherings are not allowed.
If the house rules are violated, we reserve the right to terminate the stay immediately without refund of any amounts paid.
The lead booker is responsible for all fellow guests and must ensure that they are aware of these conditions.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: The stay and the use of the accommodation and facilities are entirely at the guest's own risk.
The B&B is not liable for loss, theft or damage to guests' property, unless there is intent or gross negligence on the part of the B&B.
The B&B is only liable for direct damage that is the direct result of an attributable failure. Any liability for indirect damage or consequential loss is excluded.
If liability is established, it is limited to the amount paid out under the liability insurance, plus the applicable deductible.

sections.title: Damage and loss
paragraphs: The guest is liable for damage caused to the accommodation or inventory during the stay.
We kindly ask that any damage be reported immediately so we can work together on an appropriate solution.
In the event of intentional damage or theft, a police report will be filed and the full repair or replacement costs will be charged.
If keys are lost, the full cost of replacing keys and locks will be charged.

sections.title: Parking and bicycles
paragraphs: Parking and bicycle storage are entirely at your own risk.
The B&B is not liable for damage, loss or theft of vehicles or belongings unless there is intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: Camera surveillance
paragraphs: Camera surveillance may be used on the outdoor grounds for the protection of guests and property.
Images are only used in the event of incidents and are processed in accordance with applicable privacy legislation.

sections.title: Breakfast
paragraphs: Do you have dietary requirements or allergies? Please let us know no later than 48 hours before arrival so we can take them into account.
Breakfast is served between 08:00 and 09:30. A different time can be arranged on request.

sections.title: Cleaning
paragraphs: For multi-day stays, interim cleaning can be arranged in consultation.
This is only done on request, so that we can respect your rest and privacy.
